ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark gray/black) across >90% of the visible surface area with localized high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels corresponding to scars and barnacles.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region covering the entire fluke surface; discrete high-intensity circular rings scattered across the medial and lateral zones of both lobes; high-intensity clusters concentrated at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 45-55 degrees at the central convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; multiple sharp peaks (spires) and rounded valleys; highest amplitude peaks located mid-lobe on both sides.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trailing edge sweep transitioning to sharp, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped high-contrast pixel clusters (healed barnacle scars) visible on both lobes, particularly concentrated in the mid-horizontal plane.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, light-colored linear streaks (rake marks or scratches) visible on the lower right lobe near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified clusters (barnacles) present on the trailing edge tips; significant circular scarring across the ventral surface.
